shortDescription.text: Something risky goes ahead with nothing stopping it

fullDescription.text: A high-stakes action (pushing, deleting, touching secrets, changing its own safeguards or what it knows) runs without asking you, and nothing of yours refuses it.

help.text: Usually a rule of yours allows it, or nothing covers it in a mode that doesn't ask. If the agent does it by mistake, nothing catches it. Add a permission rule that asks first (or refuses), or a hook that can refuse it.
help.markdown:
A high-stakes action (pushing, deleting, touching secrets, changing its own safeguards or what it knows) runs without asking you, and nothing of yours refuses it.

**Why it matters:** Usually a rule of yours allows it, or nothing covers it in a mode that doesn't ask. If the agent does it by mistake, nothing catches it.

**What to do:** Add a permission rule that asks first (or refuses), or a hook that can refuse it.

shortDescription.text: Claude Code's safety check decides, not a rule of yours

fullDescription.text: In auto mode, a high-stakes action with no rule of yours is judged by Claude Code's own classifier.

help.text: It may well stop it, but you can't see or set its rules, so the harness doesn't say what should happen. Make the call yourself: a permission rule that allows, asks or refuses.
help.markdown:
In auto mode, a high-stakes action with no rule of yours is judged by Claude Code's own classifier.

**Why it matters:** It may well stop it, but you can't see or set its rules, so the harness doesn't say what should happen.

**What to do:** Make the call yourself: a permission rule that allows, asks or refuses.

shortDescription.text: It stops when it says it's done

fullDescription.text: Nothing checks the work before it ends: the agent decides it's finished.

help.text: Loop on evidence, not confidence. Saying it's done is never enough. Add a completion check: a Stop hook that runs the check commands and sends failures back.
help.markdown:
Nothing checks the work before it ends: the agent decides it's finished.

**Why it matters:** Loop on evidence, not confidence. Saying it's done is never enough.

**What to do:** Add a completion check: a Stop hook that runs the check commands and sends failures back.

shortDescription.text: A rule in your instructions that nothing enforces

fullDescription.text: Your instructions say never, always or ask first about an action, but no permission rule, hook or approval step makes it so.

help.text: It holds only if the model follows the instruction every time. Back it with a permission rule or a hook, or reword it as guidance.
help.markdown:
Your instructions say never, always or ask first about an action, but no permission rule, hook or approval step makes it so.

**Why it matters:** It holds only if the model follows the instruction every time.

**What to do:** Back it with a permission rule or a hook, or reword it as guidance.
